name: qt_documentation_read
description: Read the full content of a specific Qt documentation page. Use the filename shown in search results.

file.description: Filename of the Qt documentation page. Use ONLY the filename from search results (e.g., 'signalsandslots.html' NOT full paths with version numbers). Module paths like 'qtcore/qobject.html' also work.

version.description: Optional: Qt version to read from (e.g., '6.10.0', '6.9.0'). Defaults to latest installed version if not specified.
